summary: Give the AI worker a real caller: ingest the live stream into the journal, derive alerts from already-parsed state, and show honest status

coordination.notes: Fixes a defect in my own previous two slices: aiEventJournal, aiAlertBroker, aiJobStore, aiReviewScheduler, aiModelProvider and aiWorker had no caller anywhere in src/, which AGENTS.md forbids outright - no unused scaffolds without a current caller and an explicit product purpose. This adds the caller and the visible surface, which is also acceptance criterion 14: model failure, absence, timeout and out-of-memory must be visible. Uses the established owners rather than new paths: ingestion subscribes to gameVersion through useSyncExternalStore exactly as useGameLines.ts documents, reads gameLines() only inside the effect body and never as a dependency, and tracks an ingested count so no line is journalled twice or skipped. tools/gamelines-test.mjs scopes its raw-accessor ban to src/components; this hook is in src/lib, which that check explicitly allows for non-component code, and it follows the version-counter rule the check exists to enforce. Alerts are derived from already-parsed state - CharacterStatus.situation flags and bridgeConnected - never from a second pass over game text, so no parser is duplicated. The panel follows PresentationBridgePanel's precedent in SettingsSheet. Still no model ships and still no path to the command boundary.
